homeLauncher.scope: Additive Home documentation only; unrelated stale incumbent tokens and snippets are not regenerated or certified.
homeLauncher.geometry: Root Search at item 0 (0,0) plus six demo course buttons. ResizeObserver size=min(160,max(112,(width-64)/2.5)); spacing size+18. Desktop hexagonal rings; compact staggered two-column orbit when width<size*3+60. Item 0 remains centered in both layouts. Per-circle edgeScale unchanged: clamp(0,1,min(width/2-abs(x)-10,height/2-abs(y)-10)/(size*.6)); native hitboxes unchanged.
homeLauncher.height: Runtime inline height=max(420,ceil(2*(max(abs(y))+size*.6+14))), overriding CSS fallback. Six-course compact fields roughly 614–640px keep initial visuals scale 1. Phone page intentionally scrolls; no all-options-first-viewport promise. Search fixed 520px.
homeLauncher.containment: overflow:hidden and contain:paint; field top margin 28px, 24px mobile, root select above field. Field radius 36px/24px mobile. No circle may paint over title/description during drag.
homeLauncher.filter: Native semester select above root field defaults All semesters; sorted values derive from catalog (demo 1/3/5). Filters courses rather than navigation stages, includes courses without materials. Count derives from visible data and is labeled demo. Select type 12px, minimum height 44px. No semester bubble controls.
homeLauncher.search: Cross-semester despite root filter. Shared search-shape morph to white 72px/radius-36px input; suggestions max-height 220px. Fixed Back 88px with 28px icon, 6px gap, 10px padding and 12px/1.3 label, separate from suggestions. Back retains filter and restores Search focus.
homeLauncher.interaction: Current local-contact layout uses 18 demo courses and larger white resources max(80,round(size*.7)), with 12px labels and 24px icons. Root scale remains 1, with field-edge shrink only. Selected anchor stays fixed; colliding neighbors are pushed locally, choosing layouts with fewer affected roots and less displacement, and restore on deselection. Default field height never changes on selection. Dense catalogs use compact placement below width size*5+100. Geometry is memoized and edge shrink follows animated positions. Ring-only selection, behind-parent reveal, reduced motion, direct Search Back and inert reverse-morph source remain. This supersedes global .55 shrinking and earlier expanding rows; current evidence in docs/HOME-LAUNCHER.md.
homeLauncher.content: Shared circle content height 100% and text-align center ensure multiline centering; selected course name weight 750. Root data pending/error/refetch/empty keeps Search; missing selected course keeps Back and explicit unavailable status.
homeLauncher.provenance: Motion 14.11.1 retained, public motion/react independently implements https://motion.dev/examples/react-apple-watch-home-screen#preview. Premium Motion+ source gated, not copied. No new dependency, assets or backend; existing logo unchanged.
homeLauncher.delivery: Latest index 343.39kB (gzip 108.17kB), retained Motion chunk 167.92kB. Static imports still load Motion, not lazy loading. narrative.overview:
The user's pinned screenshot remains the shared-shell visual authority: HIMTI blue and navy, white panels, pale blue surroundings, and Plus Jakarta Sans. Academic directories retain denser cards, summary rows, and schedules. Home now follows the explicitly requested circular launcher, not the retired hero/resource feed.

Light mode is intentional to match that reference and support studying. Home's approved direction is ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 3: interactive panning and finite mode reveals, without continuous animation. This Home-specific update takes precedence over older Home hero, feed, scroll-snap, reveal, and motion statements here and in `docs/MOTION.md` or the earlier education surface brief. It does not change non-Home styling rules. See `.impeccable/surfaces/home-launcher.md` and `docs/HOME-LAUNCHER.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Blue actions, navy headings, muted academic metadata.
Rounded white panels, semantic icon tiles, and linked resource rows.
Spacious discovery, denser reading and scheduling.

rules.name: The Academic Context Rule
rules.body: Keep course, exam, period, and session metadata subordinate but legible; do not replace it with promotional badges.

dos: Do preserve the approved light HIMTI reference, existing logo, and Plus Jakarta Sans commitment.
Do keep demo academic content visibly labeled and show useful empty, loading, and error states.
Do preserve keyboard focus, mobile 16px text inputs, the scoped Home select, and local reader overflow containment.
donts: Don't invent academic claims, identities, availability, or recording links to fill panels.
Don't turn the provisional Markdown renderer into a promised Tiptap schema.
Don't let the user-requested background grid compete with reading surfaces; Home motion stays scoped to launcher interactions, not retired resource groups.
